prompt_en: Create a full-length photorealistic historical-fashion editorial: a rain-bright Art Deco ferry-terminal scene built around a qipao silhouette. Her facial structure, eye aperture and spacing, nose, lips, jawline, adult age, and long dark hair remain faithfully matched to that reference. Rain reflections, period brass and geometric glass, natural skin texture, and crisp side light softened by mist keep her face, hands, and garment construction legible.
